message.content: {"hts_code": "9505.90.6000", "reason": "The stuffed textile Thanksgiving-themed wall/door hanging decoration is a festive article for the Thanksgiving holiday, classified in the "other" subheading of HTSUS 9505.90 rather than as an apparel accessory or other textile article."}
message.reasoning:
This is a classic NY ruling style. Stuffed textile wall/door hanging decoration for Thanksgiving — classified in 9505.00 as festive article? Or 6307.90? Many such rulings: stuffed textile Halloween/Thanksgiving decorations classified in 9505.00.60 (festive articles) — but note 9505.00.60 was "festive, carnival or other entertainment articles" — actually for Thanksgiving decorations, HTS 9505.00.60 (other). Wait, 9505.00.60 was deleted? The current code: 9505.00.8000? Let me recall: 9505.00.60 "Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles" — after 2002 changes, 9505.00.60 covers articles for Christmas, 9505.00.70... Actually structure: 9505.10 Christmas articles; 9505.90 other. 9505.90.60? Hmm.

HTSUS 9505.90: "Other" — subheadings 9505.90.15? Let me recall rulings: NY N023456 etc. classify Thanksgiving decorations under 9505.90.60, duty free. Actually 9505.90.60 "Other" — 10-digit 9505.90.6000? There was 9505.90.60 (Other) with stat suffixes. Rulings cite "9505.90.6000, HTSUS, which provides for festive, carnival or other entertainment articles: other: other." Yes, that's common. Duty free.

But wait — is a Thanksgiving decoration a "festive article"? Yes, Thanksgiving is a recognized holiday; CBP classifies Thanksgiving decorations in 9505.90.60. E.g., NY ruling for stuffed fabric pumpkin decorations: 9505.90.6000.

So answer: 9505.90.6000.
